item.title: Florida After Auburn: 5 Signs Sumrall’s Gators Are Rising
item.description: Eddie Gilley breaks down Florida’s 44-39 win at Auburn: Jon Sumrall’s edge, Jadan Baugh’s 162 yards, improved line play and the penalty problem.

item.title: Saturday’s Bill Comes Due: Gators, Ole Miss, and ‘The Promise’ That Started It All
item.description: Nobody needs a sequel to what happened in that locker room. That story already got its ending — a crystal football in January. But there’s something fitting about Ole Miss being the team standing across the line as Sumrall tries to prove his Gators belong with the big boys again.

item.title: Keeping Up With Florida’s Opponents: “Heeerrrerre They Come!”
item.description: When you look at the results, Coach Sumrall is justified in saying that the Gators had been tested more than some in the media thought. The two teams the Gators have played are off to a good start in their respective seasons.

item.title: The Med School Dropout Who Made Auburn Bleed Orange and Blue
item.description: So there he was Saturday night, a game-time decision with a bad ankle, stepping into Jordan-Hare Stadium for the first time in his life — 88,000 seats, a road environment that’s swallowed better teams than this Florida bunch whole. And he treated it like a Tuesday practice.

item.title: Jadan Baugh's "another day at the office" was the difference against Auburn
item.description: Jadan Baugh (13) strikes a Heisman pose after a 53-yard TD run (Photo by Chris Spears) The play that best defined what Jadan Baugh called “another day at the office” came early in the fourth quarter, the Gators facing fourth-and-1 at their own 47. Everybody on both sidelines and all 88,000 screamers packed inside Jordan-Hare Stadium knew what was coming…
